document: v0.5 training / evaluation implementation details (not specified in dev_protocol.json)

lr_scheduler.name: torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR
lr_scheduler.momentum_note: cycle_momentum/base_momentum/max_momentum are torch defaults: AdamW beta1 is cycled 0.95 -> 0.85 -> 0.95 in the opposite phase of the lr

details.train_data: folds 1-8; RandomCropDataset (v0.4): random 250-sample crop per record per epoch, start uniform over [0, 750], per-lead normalized with folds 1-8 statistics
details.data_order: DataLoader(shuffle=True, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(run_seed), num_workers=0, pin_memory=True, drop_last=False); RandomCropDataset rng = np.random.default_rng(run_seed)
details.seeding: set_all_seeds(run_seed) (python random, numpy, torch, torch.cuda) immediately before model construction; cudnn.deterministic=True, cudnn.benchmark=False
details.training_loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss (mean over batch and the 5 classes)
details.training_loss_logging: per-epoch MEAN TRAINING loss = sample-weighted mean of batch losses over the epoch (training data only), saved per run
details.validation: NO validation metric is computed at any epoch other than the end of epoch 50; no checkpoint selection; the model after the last optimizer step is evaluated
details.evaluation: model.eval(); torch.no_grad(); 7 windows (starts [0, 125, 250, 375, 500, 625, 750]) of 250 samples per fold-9 record, per-lead normalized with folds 1-8 statistics; per-window sigmoid PROBABILITIES averaged per record (mean of probabilities, not of logits); metadata identical for all windows of a record; inference batch size 512 (no effect on results)
details.metric: macro-AUROC = mean over NORM, MI, STTC, CD, HYP of fast_auc (v0.2.1 function); verified once against sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score (abs tol 1e-09)
details.lr_tie_break: highest fold-9 macro-AUROC; if two lrs are within 0.0001 of each other, choose the SMALLER lr (implemented as: among lrs with macro-AUROC >= best - 0.0001, take the smallest)
details.per_run_outputs: v0.5_{arch}_{arm}_seed{seed}_lr{lr}_fold9_probs.csv (ecg_id, patient_id, 5 probabilities), _train_loss.csv (per-epoch mean training loss), _state_dict.pt (final model); all hashed in the manifest
details.determinism_note: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms is NOT enabled; some CUDA kernels may not be bitwise reproducible across re-runs

self_sha256_procedure: Load the JSON file; remove the key 'self_sha256' (the key must be absent, not empty); serialize the remaining dict with json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')); compute SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes; the hex digest must equal the stored 'self_sha256'. (At write time numpy scalars were converted to plain JSON types first, so the loaded file hashes identically.)
